qa_pair.question: Use k8s_list_resources to list pods in an allowlisted benchmark namespace with a simple app label selector. What fields show bounded pagination?
qa_pair.answer: total, returned, limit, offset, and hasMore.

qa_pair.answer: data, binaryData, stringData, managedFields, and last-applied configuration content must not be returned.
